headline: 134 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Little Giant Fire in WA, threatening 6,010 structures.

active_threats.name: Little Giant
active_threats.narrative: The Little Giant Fire in Chelan County, WA has burned 139,486 acres and is 12% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **6,010 structures threatened**. 1,818 personnel are assigned. Winds are expected to stay comparatively light over the next 24 hours (gusts near 11 mph), which should limit further wind-driven spread for now. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind direction (NW, blowing toward the SE) favors pushing the fire toward Leavenworth city, 30 miles away.

wind.windninja_applicability: HIGH  - core use case; downscale the sustained flow

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over OR, WA: Bend city, Kennewick city, Pasco city, Redmond city, and Walla Walla city and 14 other communities sit under an active Red Flag Warning or Watch and SPC's **Elevated** fire-weather category and NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 1,2). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 24% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
